confidence_rule.High: p >= 0.70 AND the verified sample passes the sport's minimum games
confidence_rule.Low: p < 0.60 or the sample fails the minimum
confidence_rule.Medium: p >= 0.60, or a sport whose captured sample is too small to support High

fair_price_rule: fair decimal = 1 / model probability; no margin is added or removed
market_reference_rule: OLBG rows are the public listing, not an originated line; their market-implied probability is 1/decimal and includes any margin, so they are never labelled High

baseball.why: normal run-difference scale 3.2 and home advantage 0.18 runs reflect the published 2026 regular-season run environment; totals sd 3.4 runs

basketball.why: normal EuroLeague point-difference scale 11.5 and home advantage 3.2 points; total points sd 16

ice_hockey.why: normal goal-difference scale 1.9 and home advantage 0.22 goals are the long-run NHL regular-season values; totals sd 1.9 goals per game

rugby_union.why: normal URC point-difference scale 12 and home advantage 4 points; totals sd 14. Ratings use the single completed round available, so confidence is capped

snooker.why: seed/ranking gap converted with a 22-place logistic scale; ranking data captured covers only part of the field, so confidence is capped

volleyball.why: set-difference normal scale 1.0 sets and home advantage 0.3 sets; only one completed round of the 2026-27 Serie A season existed at capture

window_arithmetic: p=0.700 prices at -233 and p=0.7143 at -250, so High (p>=0.70) and the -250 floor overlap only inside p=0.700-0.7143
window_rule: American price between -250 and +10000 inclusive, on our own fair price
